{{Infobox artifact|name=The Ash Fragments|type=Dissenting record — burned pages|keeper=Scattered; uncertain|sources=Of uncertain authenticity — dangerous because they are credible}}
The '''Ash Fragments''' are burned, incomplete pages of uncertain authenticity — the record's dissenting voice. They describe the founding war not as a defense against an outside enemy but as a ''civil war'' — '''the Divided Fire''' — and speak of an eleventh party that tried to stop the slaughter and was punished for it.

No fragment is whole. Every fragment breaks off precisely where it matters. Whether that is fire's ordinary appetite or something more careful, no one can say.
